questions.scenario: You are playing a multiplayer adventure game. What is your role on the team?

options.text: The Combat Medic: Jumping into the danger zone to instantly revive players.
The Alchemist: Brewing magic potions and antidotes in the background.
The Support Healer: Staying close to teammates and keeping their health bars full.
The Specialist: Upgrading and fixing specific armor parts or weapons precisely.

questions.scenario: A friend falls from a bicycle and scrapes their knee badly. What is your immediate reaction?

options.text: I quickly wash the wound and bandage it without feeling grossed out.
I immediately think about which antiseptic liquid or ointment is best to apply.
I hold their hand, calm them down, and make sure they stop crying.
I carefully use tweezers to pick out any tiny dirt particles from the scrape.

questions.scenario: When watching a medical drama or hospital TV show, what grabs your attention?

options.text: The intense emergency room scenes where every second is a matter of life and death.
The scenes where doctors act like detectives to find a cure for a mysterious poison.
The emotional scenes where the staff comforts a sad patient.
The perfect, clean clinics where they fix someone's smile or clear their skin.

questions.scenario: You are given a DIY craft kit. How do you approach it?

options.text: I dive right in and use tools to cut and assemble the main structure.
I carefully mix the glue or paint formulas exactly as the manual says.
I help my younger sibling build it and feel happy seeing them enjoy it.
I spend hours perfectly painting the tiniest details to make it look flawless.

questions.scenario: Which of these school science activities sounds the most interesting to you?

options.text: Learning how the heart pumps blood or dissecting a frog/flower.
Mixing different chemicals in test tubes to see them change color or react.
Learning about human psychology, sleep, and how the body heals naturally.
Looking through a microscope to observe the tiny, hidden details of a leaf.

questions.scenario: If you had a healing superpower, what would it be?

options.text: Instantly repairing broken bones or deep cuts just by touching them.
Creating a magical pill from plants that cures any disease in the world.
Taking away someone's mental and physical pain so they feel completely safe.
Making someone's teeth, face, and skin perfectly healthy and beautiful.

questions.scenario: Every job has a 'difficult' part. Which of these challenges can you tolerate the best?

options.text: Standing continuously for 10 hours without taking a break.
Memorizing thousands of complicated scientific names and formulas.
Dealing with a grumpy, crying, or irritated person with a calm smile.
Doing the exact same tiny, repetitive task perfectly 50 times.

questions.scenario: What kind of workspace sounds the most exciting to you?

options.text: A fast-paced, high-energy room full of machines where quick action is needed.
A quiet, highly advanced laboratory with lots of jars, liquids, and equipment.
A warm, comfortable room filled with people who need your daily care.
A very bright, extremely neat and organized personal clinic.

questions.scenario: You buy a brand new gadget, but a tiny screw is loose inside. What do you do?

options.text: Open the main cover confidently and fix the core issue with a tool.
Read the manual thoroughly to understand how the internal battery works.
I'd rather take care of it so it doesn't break further, and ask for help.
Use a magnifying glass and a tiny needle-like tool to carefully tighten it.

questions.scenario: In your group of friends, what title fits your personality best?

options.text: The Savior (Takes quick action in an emergency).
The Scientist (Loves logic, facts, and research).
The Caretaker (Always makes sure everyone has eaten and is happy).
The Perfectionist (Focuses on making everything look flawless and neat).
